country_event = {
	id = DA_AI_Strength.3 # a new stage: its institution has appeared in the world (DA_AI_stage_check)
	title = DA_AI_Strength.3.t
	desc = DA_AI_Strength.3.d
	picture = INVENTION_eventPicture
	is_triggered_only = yes

	trigger = {
		ai = no
		NOT = { DA_AI_level_none = yes }
	}

	option = {
		name = DA_AI_Strength.3.a
		custom_tooltip = DA_AI_tt_head_stage
		tooltip = {
			if = {
				limit = { DA_AI_level_easy = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { is_institution_enabled = industrialization }
					add_country_modifier = { name = DA_AI_Buffs_half_7 duration = -1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { is_institution_enabled = enlightenment }
					add_country_modifier = { name = DA_AI_Buffs_half_6 duration = -1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { is_institution_enabled = manufactories }
					add_country_modifier = { name = DA_AI_Buffs_half_5 duration = -1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { is_institution_enabled = global_trade }
					add_country_modifier = { name = DA_AI_Buffs_half_4 duration = -1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { is_institution_enabled = printing_press }
					add_country_modifier = { name = DA_AI_Buffs_half_3 duration = -1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { is_institution_enabled = new_world_i }
					add_country_modifier = { name = DA_AI_Buffs_half_2 duration = -1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { is_institution_enabled = renaissance }
					add_country_modifier = { name = DA_AI_Buffs_half_1 duration = -1 }
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_institution_enabled = industrialization }
					add_country_modifier = { name = DA_AI_Buffs_7 duration = -1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { is_institution_enabled = enlightenment }
					add_country_modifier = { name = DA_AI_Buffs_6 duration = -1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { is_institution_enabled = manufactories }
					add_country_modifier = { name = DA_AI_Buffs_5 duration = -1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { is_institution_enabled = global_trade }
					add_country_modifier = { name = DA_AI_Buffs_4 duration = -1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { is_institution_enabled = printing_press }
					add_country_modifier = { name = DA_AI_Buffs_3 duration = -1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { is_institution_enabled = new_world_i }
					add_country_modifier = { name = DA_AI_Buffs_2 duration = -1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { is_institution_enabled = renaissance }
					add_country_modifier = { name = DA_AI_Buffs_1 duration = -1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
